intro:
Water. Earth. Fire. Air.
Master the elements and clash as legendary characters in Avatar Legends: The Fighting Game.
description:
Featuring hand-drawn 2D animation faithful to the series’ roots, Avatar Legends: The Fighting Game lets you experience the world of Avatar like never before. Choose from 12 playable characters and go head-to-head across a variety of modes, including Offline & Online Versus, Story, Arcade, Training, Spectator, and an Art Gallery.

Standard Edition: 
 
•  Hand-Drawn 2D Animation
Hand-drawn 2D animation faithfully brings characters and their unique fighting styles from Avatar: The Last Airbender, The Legend of Korra, and the expanded universe to life.

• A Wealth of Game Modes
Includes Story Mode, Arcade Mode, Offline & Online Play, Training Mode, Spectator Mode, an Art Gallery featuring never-before-seen concept art.

•  Story and Arcade Mode
Experience an all-new original story outlined by show creators Michael Dante DiMartino and Tim Hedrick. Shape the fate of time and space in the main story mode, then dive into arcade runs featuring storylines for every playable character.

• Robust Training Mode
A Training Mode equips players of all skill levels with advanced tools, including hitboxes, frame data, save states, and more.

• Art Gallery
Explore never-before-seen original artwork from the show, honoring the history, characters, and world of Avatar.

• Easy to Pick Up, Impossible to Put Down
Anyone can start bending with simple, intuitive controls, perfect for quick matches with friends and family. Beneath the surface lies a deep fighting system rewarding technical prowess and creativity.

• Seamless Online Play
Battle players worldwide with rollback netcode and crossplay across multiple platforms. Ranked and Casual matches, lobbies, spectator mode, replays, and more ensure a competitive experience no matter where you are or who you’re fighting.

Gameplay Features

• Master Flow and Energy Points
Control the fight by using Flow to dash, evade, and outmaneuver opponents with high-speed mobility, then build Energy Points through skilled play to unleash enhanced special moves and powerful cinematic Super Arts that can turn the tide of battle.

• Support Characters
Choose from three support characters to accompany your fighter, each providing unique abilities that enhance different strengths and open up new strategic possibilities. Experiment with combinations and discover the partnership that best fits your style.
